description: CIS zastávky ÚK is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ústecký kraj. Stops processed from JDF files for the Ústí Region. The data provider is CIS. The method returns a list of stops consisting of a combination of nodes/columns. The optional "carrier" parameter can be used to obtain stops for a specific carrier only. Coverage: Ústecký kraj. The portal shows the English title as "CIS stops in the Ústí Region" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ústecký kraj. Its keywords include transit, CIS, zastávky, doprava, stops, JDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/70892156/1fdd8e72bedfc2cf53c322f799937ef3/distribuce/774363d4facde16c554f97b586a83819/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
